name: VoiceChannelLog
author: Bluscream (bluscream_)
short: Logs voice joins, leaves, moves, mutes, cameras and streams to the voice channel's text chat.
description: Port of the Equicord voiceChannelLog plugin. Posts connect/disconnect/move, self and server mute/deafen, camera and stream events into the voice channel's built-in text chat (or a same-named text channel in the same category), with per-event toggles, custom templates and an optional webhook author name/avatar.
install_msg: Thanks for installing VoiceChannelLog! Run `[p]vclog enable` in your server, then `[p]vclog settings` to see the events and templates.
end_user_data_statement: This cog stores no personal data. It only keeps per-server settings (enabled events, message templates and ignored channels).
